description: Crack open a virtual fortune cookie — 40 original fortunes, each with six lucky numbers, ready to copy or share.

faqs.a: 40 original fortunes about luck, love, success, and adventure — plus six random lucky numbers each.
faqs.q: What do I get per cookie?

faqs.a: Lucky numbers are random picks from 1–99, just like a real cookie slip.
Click the fortune or its Copy button to copy the fortune and numbers together.
faqs.q: How do I copy a fortune?

howto: Read your fortune and lucky numbers.
Click to copy or crack another.
title: Fortune Cookie Generator
